name: Custom note preview styling
description:
With this script you can add custom stylesheets to the note preview. Please refer to the litehtml HTML and CSS support documentation for information about supported styling features. These styles will also affect the PDF-export.

The body tag of the generated html of a note has a css class preview for the preview and and export for the export, so that you can more easily append different styles for the preview and export (e.g. body.export img { width: 200px } to resize images for the export).
